label.zh-TW: 康是美網購eShop 邀請好友活動頁

title.zh-TW: 首次購買滿 NT$1,000，現折 NT$100
title.en: NT$100 off a first purchase of NT$1,000 or more

text.zh-TW: 結帳時輸入優惠碼 MGMBK5ZTN，訂單現折 NT$100；限首次購買。取自平台分享文案與邀請頁；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: Enter promo code MGMBK5ZTN at checkout for NT$100 off; first purchase only. From the share text and invite page; official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟推薦連結（會前往康是美網購eShop 的邀請頁）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (it leads to the Cosmed online shop invitation page).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示登入或註冊康是美網購eShop 會員。
steps.en: Log in or register as a member of the Cosmed online shop as the page asks.

steps.zh-TW: 選購商品，讓首次購買的訂單金額達 NT$1,000 以上。
steps.en: Shop so that your first purchase order reaches NT$1,000 or more.

steps.zh-TW: 結帳時輸入優惠碼 MGMBK5ZTN（已包含在連結中；若結帳頁沒有自動帶入，請手動輸入），訂單即現折 NT$100。
steps.en: At checkout, enter promo code MGMBK5ZTN (already in the link; if it is not filled in, type it in) for NT$100 off the order.

intro.zh-TW: 康是美網購eShop 首次購買訂單滿 NT$1,000，結帳輸入優惠碼 MGMBK5ZTN，訂單現折 NT$100。
intro.en: Cosmed’s online shop: on a first purchase of NT$1,000 or more, enter promo code MGMBK5ZTN at checkout for NT$100 off.

description.zh-TW:
康是美（Cosmed）是台灣的連鎖藥妝與美妝零售通路，「康是美網購eShop」是它的線上購物平台。透過本頁連結開啟邀請頁時，優惠碼 MGMBK5ZTN 已包含在連結中；依康是美的邀請頁，好友限首次購買，單筆訂單消費達 NT$1,000（含）以上即可使用優惠碼，訂單現折 NT$100。若結帳時需要輸入，請依原樣（含大小寫）輸入。

依邀請頁顯示，活動期間為 2026-10-23 至 2026-11-19；首張訂單若有取消或退貨，之後再下單就沒有這項優惠。實際內容、金額與期限以康是美官方公告為準。
description.en:
Cosmed is a drugstore and beauty retail chain in Taiwan, and 康是美網購eShop (the Cosmed online shop) is its online store. The promo code MGMBK5ZTN is already part of the referral link on this page. According to Cosmed’s invitation page, an invited friend can use the promo code only on a first purchase, and a single order of NT$1,000 or more gets NT$100 off. If the code is needed at checkout, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization.

The invitation page shows a campaign period of 2026-10-23 to 2026-11-19, and if the first order is cancelled or returned, later orders no longer get the offer. Actual terms, amounts and deadlines follow Cosmed’s official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 優惠碼 MGMBK5ZTN 已包含在連結中；手動輸入時請依原樣（含大小寫）。折扣限首次購買、單筆訂單消費達 NT$1,000（含）以上；依邀請頁，首張訂單若有取消或退貨，之後再下單沒有這項優惠，活動期間為 2026-10-23 至 2026-11-19。邀請頁沒有說明優惠碼的使用次數上限，請以康是美官方公告為準。
notes.en: Promo code MGMBK5ZTN is already part of the link; if you type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization. The discount applies to a first purchase on a single order of NT$1,000 or more; per the invitation page, if the first order is cancelled or returned, later orders get no offer, and the campaign period is 2026-10-23 to 2026-11-19. The invitation page does not state a usage limit for the code, so Cosmed’s official announcements prevail.

q.zh-TW: MGMBK5ZTN 這組優惠碼在康是美網購eShop 怎麼使用？
q.en: How do I use promo code MGMBK5ZTN at the Cosmed online shop?

a.zh-TW: 依康是美的邀請頁，限首次購買，單筆訂單消費達 NT$1,000（含）以上，結帳時使用優惠碼 MGMBK5ZTN，訂單現折 NT$100。本頁連結已包含這組優惠碼；若結帳時需要輸入，請依原樣（含大小寫）輸入。
a.en: According to Cosmed’s invitation page, on a first purchase only, a single order of NT$1,000 or more gets NT$100 off when you use promo code MGMBK5ZTN at checkout. The code is already part of the link on this page; if you need to type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization.

q.zh-TW: 這個折扣是給誰的？有活動期限嗎？
q.en: Who gets the discount, and is there a deadline?

a.zh-TW: 折扣給被邀請的好友，也就是使用這組優惠碼的人，限在官網或 App 完成第一筆訂單；首單若有取消或退貨，之後再下單沒有這項優惠。邀請頁顯示的活動期間是 2026-10-23 至 2026-11-19，實際條件以康是美官方公告為準。
a.en: The discount is for the invited friend who uses the promo code, and only on the first order placed on the website or in the app; if that first order is cancelled or returned, later orders get no offer. The invitation page shows a campaign period of 2026-10-23 to 2026-11-19, and actual terms follow Cosmed’s official announcements.
